gpu_tip: ~31GB total at 128K context — the smallest Granite 4.2 30B build, for when nothing larger fits. Quality drops noticeably at 2-bit, and ~18GB of the total is KV cache, so the KV cache knob's q4_0 option is often the better saving. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus a 32GB DDR5 kit covers it via llama.cpp's layer offloading.
mac_tip: Needs ~31GB — a 32GB MacBook Pro (M4 or M5) is right at the limit; a 36GB or 48GB config is safer.
